decisions.reason: A core piqué upholstery fabric close to the established offer, with its own website page, typically stays in the collection for several seasons.
The semi-transparent bouclé decorative fabric still fits curtain trends, though as only a mention on the website it is more exposed to collection pruning as it ages.
Flame-retardant curtain fabrics serve steady contract and hospitality demand and usually have long life cycles.
The wool bouclé leno supports the shift to renewable materials, although the earlier withdrawal of the wool-blend Product D suggests some risk.
Launched in 2024 with its own website page, the braided-structure fabric is too new to withdraw.
